title: List the catalog
description: Every tool in the catalog, in ID order, with its status.

title: Get a month's outcome measures
description: The measures for the one month asked for, given as YYYY-MM and counted as of the moment it runs, each with the counts behind it: loans and tools, loans due and late.

title: Find a loan
description: The active loan of one tool, found by the ID on the tool's tag, with its member and due date; none when the tool is not on loan.

title: List the tools waiting for repair
description: Every tool that needs repair, the oldest damage report first, each with its damage note, when the damage was reported and whether it is still on loan.
